info.about: Robot Alchemic Drive or R.A.D., sold in Japan as Gigantic Drive is a 2002 action-adventure mecha fighting video game developed by Sandlot and published by Enix for the PlayStation 2.
info.trivia: You mostly play as the giant robot's human pilot rather than the robot itself, a design from Sandlot, the studio behind Earth Defense Force.
info.why: It sold poorly on its 2002 release and is now considered a niche title, so few North American copies exist for the cult following it later found.
